payload.description: Determine whether the existing Amplify dashboard Task model can be the single authoritative command lifecycle record. Experiment only: add scalar lease, digest, fencing, idempotency, and cancellation fields to dashboard/amplify/data/resource.ts without adding a Command model, relationship, or index. Prove CloudFormation resource-count/replacement behavior, conditional claim and fencing semantics, and dashboard Task subscription updates. Restore experimental files after validation; do not modify command-worker production code.
payload.title: Experiment: use dashboard Task as authoritative command lifecycle
